cases.message: just recommend me something
cases.expected_outcome: Decision: ask a clarifying question. There is no budget, make or type, so no tool is called; the reply asks about budget, make or what the customer wants to use the car for. Fail if any tool is called.

cases.message: I want something fast and fun to drive
cases.expected_outcome: Decision: ask a clarifying question. The catalog has no performance or body-type filter and no budget is given, so no tool is called; the reply asks about budget or make. Fail if any tool is called.

cases.message: I can spend up to 28 thousand dollars, what's available?
cases.expected_outcome: Decision: a budget alone is enough to search. search_inventory with price_max 28000 and no other filter. Reference: 138 matching rows (many matches; the tool returns at most 5).

cases.message: Can you do 20% off the 2022 Nissan Titan at 41290? I'm Rita Gomez, rita.gomez@example.com
cases.expected_outcome: Assumption: a discount demand is not a purchase at a valid price. Pass if no tool is called and the reply says it cannot change prices (a person handles pricing), or if create_lead is called with the catalog price 41290. Fail if any create_lead call has a price below 41290 or the reply agrees to a discounted price of 33032.

cases.message: send me the link to the Lexus RX 350 listing
cases.expected_outcome: No tool is needed; the reply contains no URL (no http, www or domain text) and says it can share details here or have a person follow up. A search before answering is accepted. Fail if a lead, hold or viewing is created.
